preconditions.what: Pass 0 decision gate recorded as go

phases.goal: Implement the exact bilingual enrollment scripts and consent-gated state machine for AC1 and AC2.
constraints: Use the eight Korean and eight English sentences in the approved proposal without rewriting them.
Require biometric consent before placement, eight sentences, 20–30 seconds of free speech, random-phrase check, baseline and done.
A failed check offers two additional sentences; no path reaches done without consent.
phases.check: grep -rqE 'func enrollmentScriptsHaveRequiredRegisterSplit' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && grep -rqE 'func enrollmentFlowRequiresConsentAndRecovery' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && swift test --filter 'enrollmentScriptsHaveRequiredRegisterSplit|enrollmentFlowRequiresConsentAndRecovery'
phases.handoff: Tested scripts and enrollment transitions are available to profile storage and onboarding.

phases.goal: Persist a protected voice profile across relaunch, restore it into the diarizer without re-enrollment, and delete it in one call for AC3.
constraints: Prefer stored embeddings; if FluidAudio cannot restore from embeddings, store the required enrollment audio on the phone under the same biometric consent and record the fallback in progress.md.
Apply complete file protection to every persisted profile file, including fallback audio.
Test a fresh store instance reading the profile and a diarizer adapter accepting it; connect that adapter to the iOS diarizer.
Never send audio, text or voiceprint off the phone.
phases.check: grep -rqE 'func voiceProfileStoreSurvivesRelaunchAndDeletes' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && grep -rqE 'func diarizerAdapterAcceptsStoredProfile' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && swift test --filter 'voiceProfileStoreSurvivesRelaunchAndDeletes|diarizerAdapterAcceptsStoredProfile' && xtool dev build
phases.handoff: The protected profile restores user attribution after relaunch; its actual storage format is documented.

phases.goal: Read Korean register against the session setting using at least 30 labelled phrases for AC4.
constraints: Cover 하십시오체, 해요체, 반말 and mixed endings.
Return aligned, check or unknown; abstain when evidence is insufficient.
Keep rules and fixtures on the phone.
phases.handoff: The Korean register reader has a passing 30-phrase fixture and a stable result contract.

phases.goal: Add English formality and Korean/English intention-sensitive word-choice readings for AC5 and AC6.
constraints: Test English formality on at least 20 labelled phrases.
A phrase flagged under gentle must not be flagged when blunt wording is confirmed as acceptable.
Use an on-device lexicon whose licence permits open-source redistribution.
phases.check: grep -rqE 'func englishRegisterTwentyPhraseFixture' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && grep -rqE 'func wordChoiceRespectsBluntIntention' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && swift test --filter 'englishRegisterTwentyPhraseFixture|wordChoiceRespectsBluntIntention'
phases.handoff: Both shipped reading categories work in Korean and English through local interfaces.

phases.goal: Implement confirmed per-category intention settings, weighting and unmeasured slots for AC7, AC9 and the logic of AC12.
constraints: Keep free-text intention separately from confirmed register and word-choice settings.
Presets fill proposed settings but do not affect readers until the user confirms them.
A confirmed intended mode never produces a mismatch in its category; document the weighting table in code.
Sarcasm, tone/manner and sharp/stiff always return notMeasured.
phases.check: grep -rqE 'func intentionWeightingTableSuppressesChosenModes' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && grep -rqE 'func confirmedCategorySettingsDriveReaders' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && grep -rqE 'func unconfirmedPresetDoesNotChangeReadings' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && grep -rqE 'func unmeasuredCategoriesAlwaysAbstain' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && swift test --filter 'intentionWeightingTableSuppressesChosenModes|confirmedCategorySettingsDriveReaders|unconfirmedPresetDoesNotChangeReadings|unmeasuredCategoriesAlwaysAbstain'
phases.handoff: Setup state has a tested confirmation boundary, and readers accept only confirmed category settings.

phases.goal: Connect completed phrases to the readers through an own-speech gate for AC8.
constraints: Produce no reading or haptic for other, unknown, confidence below 0.6 or overlapping speech.
Apply attribution before analysis and before cue delivery if attribution changes.
Uncertain or unfinished phrases stay quiet; preserve the Pass 0 evidence path.
phases.handoff: The live pipeline emits readings only for completed, confidently attributed user phrases.

phases.goal: Build enrollment and session setup UI with confirmed category settings and bilingual copy for AC11 and the UI of AC12.
constraints: Use the P1 flow and P2 store; keep biometric consent separate from recording consent.
Show and store free-text intention, but never parse it into a category setting without confirmation.
Offer register and word-choice controls plus presets; disclose whether the actual profile format retains enrollment audio.
Localize every new user-facing key in Korean and English; use warm, conditional copy without asserting the other person's feelings.
Follow the settled DESIGN.md scheme.
phases.check: grep -rqE 'func pass1CopyIsBilingualAndAvoidsForbiddenClaims' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && grep -rqE 'func enrollmentOnboardingRequiresConsent' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && grep -rqE 'func sessionSetupConfirmsCategorySettings' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && swift test --filter 'pass1CopyIsBilingualAndAvoidsForbiddenClaims|enrollmentOnboardingRequiresConsent|sessionSetupConfirmsCategorySettings' && xtool dev build
phases.handoff: Compiled onboarding and setup screens expose the tested confirmation boundary with checked bilingual copy.

phases.goal: Build DESIGN.md live states, connect the gated readings and haptic, and prove app wiring for AC10 and AC13.
constraints: Keep one top recording strip and a round meter with ticks only on the reachable upper arc.
The tappable cue card shows the exact user phrase, a conditional possible reading, its confirmed intention link and one suggested next sentence.
Test idle, reading, cue-card and recording-stopped view-model states.
Show three not-yet-measured slots; extend the Simulator self-test to exercise enrollment and reading paths before its existing sentinel.
Do not add recap, calendar, cloud analysis or user-data transmission.
phases.check: grep -rqE 'func liveViewModelStatesAndCueCardContents' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && grep -rqE 'func liveMeterGeometryKeepsLowerTicksAbsent' Tests/AutoniteCoreTests && swift test --filter 'liveViewModelStatesAndCueCardContents|liveMeterGeometryKeepsLowerTicksAbsent' && xtool dev build && SIMCTL_CHILD_AUTONITE_SELFTEST=1 python3 "$HOME/projects/agent-skills/ios-xtool/scripts/xtkit.py" simtest . --sentinel 'autonite selftest succeeded'
phases.handoff: Pass 1 builds, its Simulator self-test reaches the sentinel, and live-screen device review can begin.

end_gate.what: Enrollment matches the user at about 40 cm and 1 m without matching the other speaker, in Korean and English.
end_gate.why_not_automatic: Real voices, microphone placement and room acoustics determine match quality.

end_gate.what: The short haptic is felt with the iPhone face-up on a table while recording.
end_gate.why_not_automatic: Simulator tests cannot measure what a person feels.

end_gate.what: Korean copy sounds warm and natural.
end_gate.why_not_automatic: Tone and cultural fit require Danny's judgment.

end_gate.what: The Korean register reading is useful during a real conversation.
end_gate.why_not_automatic: Fixture accuracy cannot establish usefulness or interruption cost.

end_gate.what: Live cues arrive soon enough and never fire on the other person's speech in a two-person device trial.
end_gate.why_not_automatic: End-to-end timing and attribution depend on real speech and device conditions.

end_gate.what: The AC13 screen follows DESIGN.md on device: one recording strip, round meter with upper-only ticks, and a readable cue card with all four required fields.
end_gate.why_not_automatic: View-model tests and Simulator launch do not establish the rendered screen's legibility or layout.
